categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies net_processing.cpp and headerssync.h to prevent chain sync eviction during headers presync.
categories.rationale: Fixes a sync liveness bug where nodes on high-latency networks like Tor or I2P repeatedly evict active sync peers. Chain sync eviction previously failed to account for anti-DoS presync headers progress, disconnecting peers after ~22 minutes when ~480 round trips take longer than 2.5s each.
